results.title: Panel sections order: Related Prompts first, Cited URLs second

steps.title: Given the user is on the adidas dashboard Sources section
When the user clicks a source row to open the details panel
Then the panel shows 'Prompts associés' section first, followed by 'URL citées' section, with no per-engine citation-count block

results.notes: Panel header: 'Détails des sources de citation des moteurs IA'. Section order confirmed: 'Prompts associés' (with preview rows) appears above 'URL citées (N)'.

results.title: Related Prompts preview shows prompt texts with engine icons and 'All related Prompts (N)' control

steps.title: Given the source details panel is open
When the user views the Prompts associés section
Then up to 5 prompt preview rows appear with engine icons, and a 'Tous les prompts associés (N)' link control is shown at the bottom

results.notes: Preview shows prompt texts (e.g. 'De bonnes chaussures de sport ?') with engine icons (Gemini, ChatGPT). 'Tous les prompts associés 26' link visible at the bottom of the prompts section.

results.title: Cited URLs section shows count heading and URL rows with 'All Cited URLs (N)' control

steps.title: Given the source details panel is open
When the user scrolls to the Cited URLs section
Then 'URL citées (27)' heading appears with URL rows showing favicon, title, address and engine icons

results.notes: Section heading 'URL citées (27)' confirmed. URL rows show domain favicon, page title, full URL and engine icons.

results.title: 'All related Prompts' modal opens with correct header, prompt count, search field, and full list

steps.title: Given the source details panel is open showing 'Tous les prompts associés (N)' control
When the user clicks 'Tous les prompts associés'
Then a modal opens with header 'Tous les prompts associés - {domain}', total prompt count, 'Rechercher des prompts' search field, and full prompt list

results.notes: Modal header: 'Tous les prompts associés - frmf.ma' with '18 prompts'. Search field 'Rechercher des prompts' visible. Full list of prompts displayed.

results.title: Modal shows 4 tabs (ALL, Visibility, Competitive, Perception) each with count, ALL selected by default

steps.title: Given the 'Tous les prompts associés' modal is open
When the modal is first displayed
Then 4 tabs are visible: TOUS (selected by default), Visibilité N, Concurrentiel N, Perception N — each showing its count

results.notes: For frmf.ma: TOUS (selected), Visibilité 8, Concurrentiel 10, Perception 0. For co.ma: TOUS, Visibilité 8, Concurrentiel 10, Perception 8.

results.title: Multi-engine prompts appear as single rows with all engine icons

steps.title: Given the 'Tous les prompts associés' modal is open showing the TOUS tab
When the user inspects prompt rows that appear on multiple engines
Then prompts cited by multiple engines appear as a single row with multiple engine icons displayed together

results.notes: Confirmed: rows like 'Compare Toyota, Hyundai, Tesla and Ford for Electric Cars?' show multiple engine icons (e.g. Gemini + ChatGPT) in a single row rather than duplicate rows per engine.

results.title: 'All Cited URLs' modal opens with correct header, count, search field, and URL rows

steps.title: Given the source details panel is open showing 'Toutes les URLs citées (N)' control
When the user clicks the 'Toutes les URLs citées' control
Then a modal opens with 'URLs citées - {domain}' header, URL count, search field, and URL rows with favicon, title, address and engine icons

results.notes: Modal confirmed: header includes domain name and count. URL rows display favicon, page title, URL address, and engine icons.

results.title: Search in Visibility tab filters to Visibility tab prompts only

steps.title: Given the modal is open on the Visibilité tab
When the user types a search term in 'Rechercher des prompts'
Then results are filtered to show only Visibility-tab prompts matching the search term

results.notes: Search field filters prompts within the active tab scope. Confirmed search narrows the Visibilité tab results independently.

results.title: Competitive tab with 0 prompts shows empty state, other tabs remain accessible

steps.title: Given the modal is open for a source with Perception tab count of 0 (frmf.ma: Perception 0)
When the user clicks the Perception tab (count 0)
Then the tab body shows an empty state message and the other tabs (TOUS, Visibilité, Concurrentiel) remain clickable and accessible

results.notes: PARTIAL: Perception tab (count 0) for frmf.ma showed an empty list area. Other tabs remained accessible. However, no specific empty-state message text (e.g. 'No prompts found') was confirmed visible in the DOM — the tab area was simply empty. Other tabs remained clickable and functional.

results.title: Prompt count in panel control matches modal header and tab sum

steps.title: Given the source details panel is open showing 'Tous les prompts associés (N)' control
When the user clicks the control to open the modal
Then the count N in the panel control equals the modal header count, and equals the sum of all tab counts (Visibilité + Concurrentiel + Perception)

results.notes: For frmf.ma: panel control shows 18, modal header '18 prompts', tab sum Visibilité(8) + Concurrentiel(10) + Perception(0) = 18. For co.ma: panel 26, modal '26 prompts', tab sum 8+10+8 = 26. All counts agree.

results.title: Perception tab shows questions (1 row per question, not per concept), count matches unique questions displayed

steps.title: Given the 'Tous les prompts associés' modal is open for a source with Perception prompts (co.ma, Perception 8)
When the user clicks the Perception tab
Then rows represent full question strings (1 row per unique question, not per concept), and the displayed count equals the tab badge count of 8

results.notes: Perception tab for co.ma shows 8 unique full-question rows: e.g. 'Que penses-tu d’adidas pour les chaussures de sport ?', 'Quelle est la réputation d’adidas...', etc. JS count confirmed 8 lines ending with '?'. No concept-level fragmentation observed.

results.title: Panel respects active dashboard scope (France + Claude + Last 7 days)

steps.title: Given the dashboard with France + Claude + Last 7 days scope
When the user opens a source panel
Then the panel reflects only prompts and URLs matching the scope

results.notes: SKIP: Claude engine toggle is disabled/greyed-out on this dashboard (confirmed via LLM filter dropdown). The France + Claude + Last 7 days precondition cannot be configured. Screenshot shows Claude toggle in disabled state alongside active ChatGPT and Gemini.

results.title: Panel scope follows dashboard exactly, no 7-day floor (e.g. 3-day range)

steps.title: Given the dashboard date range is set to a sub-7-day range (e.g. 3 days)
When the user opens a source panel
Then the panel reflects the 3-day scope, not a forced 7-day minimum

results.notes: SKIP: No sub-7-day date range option exists in staging. The date picker minimum is '7 derniers jours' (last 7 days). Screenshot shows date picker calendar confirming no 3-day or similar short-range option is available.
